findings.title: Core daemon does not self-enforce 0700 permissions on its socket/home directory
findings.summary: TRUST_BOUNDARIES.md requires the local socket directory and file permissions to deny other local users. The daemon hardens only the socket file (chmod 0o600 at nemesis_core_daemon.adb:456-465) and creates its home via Ada.Directories.Create_Path (:442) with default umask; it never chmods its home/socket directory to 0700. In the audited desktop flow this is mitigated (0600 socket denies connection regardless of dir perms; the app-data root is set 0700 by production.rs; run_local_mission pre-creates core_home 0700 via ensure_private_directory), so it is not exploitable within the product, but the daemon does not self-enforce the documented directory invariant and the intermediate .core directory is left at default perms.

locations.role: ensure_private_directory (the 0700 helper the daemon path does not use)

evidence.label: socket file hardened but directory is not
evidence.explanation: Only the socket file is chmod'd 0o600; the home/socket directory is created with default umask permissions by Create_Path.
evidence.excerpt: Ada.Directories.Create_Path (To_String (Home));  ...  Code := C_Chmod (Path, 16#180#); -- 0o600 on core.sock only

evidence.label: mitigation in desktop flow
evidence.explanation: The socket file at 0600 denies connections from other local users regardless of directory perms; the app-data root and core_home reach 0700 through production.rs, so the boundary holds within the audited product.

optionalProperties.precondition: Core launched with a --home whose parent chain is not already 0700, or reliance on the intermediate .core directory created by create_dir_all.
optionalProperties.impact: Documented 'socket directory must deny other local users' invariant is enforced only indirectly (via socket-file mode and caller-set root perms), not self-enforced by the daemon.
optionalProperties.remediation: Daemon should chmod its home directory to 0700 immediately after Create_Path; mission_runner should create core_home and the .core intermediate through ensure_private_directory.
optionalProperties.verdict_effect: informational only; does not downgrade CLEAN verdict
